history.prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look, wide establishing composition. A complex physical relay bypass mechanism heavily wired with glowing amber copper cables around a dark logic board, set inside a moody, empty control room at dusk. Deep atmospheric haze, restrained teal-and-amber palette. Single strong practical amber worklight illuminating the intricate physical routing switches and frosted optical cables. Brushed metal textures, heavy mechanical switches implied to be shifting paths, editorial elegance, generous negative space.

style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly resting on a weathered brushed steel workbench. Two recognizable engineered parts: a heavy, unlatched diagnostic bay cover and an interlocking optical connector piece, pulled slightly apart to indicate they are swappable. Arranged asymmetrically with generous editorial negative space on the left. Matte muted palette of industrial grey and frosted copper, hard clean edges, single directional key light throwing a long, deliberate cast shadow across the tactile metallic surface. No printed lettering.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmarks, logos, watermarks, UI, faces, hands, bare abstract geometry
rationale: The story focuses on a specific, swappable element (the judge) within a broader system (AI observability). A modular component assembly captures the idea of an interchangeable testing unit that dictates the final score.
subject: an unlatched modular diagnostic bay and an interlocking connector
composition: extreme asymmetry with heavy negative space
alt_text: An unlatched modular diagnostic bay and an interlocking connector resting on a brushed steel surface.
caption: Because AI quality scores vary heavily depending on the model chosen to evaluate them, the industry standard remains a moving target.
title: AI Judge Swappable Module
